create_dynamicreplica_dataset: create a DynamicReplicaWAI dataset instance with a specified split, root directory, and resolution
run_dynamicreplica_cli: run the DynamicReplicaWAI module via CLI to load and visualize dataset scenes with rerun
sample_views_from_scene: sample N views from a DynamicReplica scene using pairwise covisibility and return image, depth, and pose data
load_scene_metadata: load scene metadata and covisibility maps for a DynamicReplica scene from WAI format data
visualize_dataset_views: visualize DynamicReplica dataset views including RGB images, depth maps, camera poses, and 3D point clouds in rerun
